name: Verified container artifact
summary: Produce a scanned and signed artifact tied to source.
use_when: A product publishes deployable container images.
proposed_guarantees: Verified digest returned only after required checks
failure_modes: Published image mistaken for approved image

evidence.basis: Candidate boundary informed by maintainer source inspection; identifying evidence is not published. No AMSL consumer adoption is claimed.

alternatives.name: Sigstore Cosign
alternatives.assessment: Use established signing tooling; specify promotion gates.

open_questions: Define scan failure and provenance verification behavior.
